fix_round.1_partial_move_data_loss: _move_verified never deletes the archive copies once ANY source file was unlinked: on a failure after the first unlink BOTH sides are kept (remaining source files AND the sha-verified copies), a sealed PARTIAL.json marker (slim_sha256-style 'partial_sha256' seal) is written into the branch dir, SlimPartial is raised and slim_record/migrate STOP (nothing else moves until an operator reconciles; the branch re-runs as full_restored). Failures BEFORE the first unlink still clean the partial copies (unchanged). The live path now unlinks the MARKER before the payload, so a mid-unlink failure at worst leaves a full_restored branch, never a half tape
fix_round.2_extra_seeds: rejected_candidates handles ANY seed_index (extra_seeds append seed_index>=3 examples); slim_plan covers the extra-seed roots confirm_seed{k}_all8 (group; record['extra'][k]['candidates'] maps position -> branch index because that verification holds only the cooperative candidates) and confirm_extended_seed{k}_all8 (extended candidate_indices), on the real merged layout; quote() survives ANY planning exception (not only SlimError) and reports that record with zero branches
fix_round.3_config_key: bank_builder.run_all8_round reads slim_rejected_tapes from its BINDING/config (absent/None = the C4NM_SLIM_REJECTED_TAPES env var decides) and passes it to confirm_all8; the claim records the option; slim_tapes.enabled accepts string forms ('1'/'true'/'on' ON, '0'/''/'false' OFF)
fix_round.4_slim_record_never_fails: slim_record catches ANY Exception per branch (was SlimError/(OSError,ValueError,KeyError)), records it in 'errors', keeps the tape and NEVER raises; a SlimPartial additionally stops the record's loop; confirm_all8 wraps the post-seal slim_record call so a slimming crash can never fail the sealed record
fix_round.migrate_fix: migrate propagates full_restored/no_tape counts and reports/propagates the STOP after a partial ('partial': <vid>)

migration.rule: one-off for EXISTING sealed decisions: copies RESULT.json(.gz) into the bank-relative archive layout, sha256-verifies the copies (file digests + decompressed payload vs marker sha + sealed result digest), writes SLIM.json into the branch dir, only then drops the source; never deletes without verification, never touches admitted/reference/solo tapes; any failure BEFORE the first source unlink restores the branch untouched; a failure AFTER a source was unlinked keeps BOTH sides, writes sealed PARTIAL.json and STOPS the run (idempotent re-run moves the rest and reports the partial branch as full_restored); archive dir must be outside the bank (operator rsyncs the target to another host)
